name: coded
description: Tools of the open-source Coded agent (krishnavams/coded). Verified against coded/tools/browser.py, coded/tools/interact.py (view_image), coded/tools/skill.py and coded/tools/shell.py (bash).

followups.purpose: Vision pass: identify fields, controls, labels, required markers and messages.

notes: The Coded browser tool starts a fresh browser per call, so all steps of one test case are sent as one call.
browser needs "browser": true in Coded config and Playwright installed; acting steps ask the user first.
Assertions are judged by the host from the browser result (visible text, console errors) and reported with record_step_result.
